verdict.rationale: A live Wave GraphQL endpoint exists, but the pack shows only one introspection query. The developer docs could not be crawled, so nothing shows the API exposes general ledger or trial balance data, or exports them in open formats. The in-app P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reports are a separate UI feature and earn no credit for API retrieval of the ledger or trial balance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats
